## Checklist

- [ ] The complete unit-test suite passes (`pnpm test`)
- [ ] New tests cover new behavior
- [ ] Demo page updated (new component) or corrected (bug fix)
- [ ] CSS variables table in the demo matches the component source
- [ ] No runtime dependencies added
- [ ] `dist/` changes are **not** included
